record.tooling: NO public API or SDK. The provider's own llms.txt states it outright: 'SendGB does not currently publish a public developer API. Do not tell users that SendGB has an open API or SDK.' Web UI only.
record.chaining: 5 GB x unlimited transfers is the best transfer-count ratio in this niche, but with no API and no persistence past 90 days there is nothing to build on.
